notes.title: ✨ A huge thank you to all of you! ✨
notes.content:
Dear B.E.S.T.I.E.S,
With the release of Episode 5, we’ve reached a very important milestone: the end of B.E.S.T’s Early Access.
And thanks to you, this weekend has been incredible:

The game was played by over 100 players simultaneously all weekend long 🎮

Already more than 1,000 wishlists for B.E.S.T 2 in just a few days!

And most importantly… a release with no major bugs 🎉

Your feedback has been overwhelmingly positive: you highlight the visual quality, the characters, and the challenges — and that motivates us so much.
We also know that some of you would like to see more narrative depth, better pacing, or longer and more detailed scenes. These insights are precious — they help us aim higher for what’s next.
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/3eca2906b5ffca4c222fbd7312fee49362392825.png"]
🔮 What’s next?
To explain our vision more clearly, let’s take the example of Captain Tsubasa ⚽.
Each arc ends with a big tournament… and then a new arc begins, with bigger stakes, new opponents, but always with continuity for the characters.

That’s exactly the idea with B.E.S.T:

Episode 5 marks the end of Early Access, but the narrative arc isn’t over yet.

Episode 6 will bring this arc to a conclusion: it will serve both as an epilogue and an introduction to the next one.

And B.E.S.T 2 will be that new arc: a direct continuation, but also designed so that new players can jump in and enjoy it.
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/8712d432d369183d529cd709377f3e694b1f7d5e.png"]
💬 Why your reviews matter so much
Your Steam reviews aren’t just feedback for us — they directly determine the game’s visibility.
Right now, we’re sitting at around 80% “Very Positive” — and that’s thanks to you.
Keeping that rating is key for us to be able to bring you Episode 6 and to prepare an even more ambitious B.E.S.T 2.

🙏 If you enjoyed your experience, please leave a review on Steam. It helps us tremendously and gets us closer to giving you that extra episode.
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/5368068031023336b987915d0fe2a2afa731d980.png"]
🗣️ Putting the community at the heart of B.E.S.T 2
We want to involve the community even more in the development of B.E.S.T 2. Your opinions, wishes, and ideas will guide our choices so you get the game you truly hope for.

And to start right now, here’s our first open question:

👉 In Season 1, you took part in a football (soccer) tournament. For the next arc, what would you prefer?
⚽ Keep this type of sports events outside of the B.E.S.T competition?

🏀 Try a different sport for a change of pace?

🎯 Or focus solely on the B.E.S.T competition and leave the sports aside?

We can’t wait to read your answers and build the future together.
[hr][/hr]
Once again, thank you for all your support since the very beginning.
Episode 5 marks the end of one stage, but the story continues: the B.E.S.T arc will conclude with Episode 6, and a new one will begin with B.E.S.T 2.



❤️ The Dolydev Team

notes.title: 🔔 One Month Until B.E.S.T's Full Release… Or Not?
notes.content:
Hey B.E.S.T.I.E.S !


Here we are: 30 days to go before the official release of B.E.S.T on August 29, 2025. That’s huge for us — more than two years of development, passion, struggles, and incredible moments with all of you.

But today, we want to take a moment to talk to you openly and honestly.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/c497ef68e185e50f6d1b9c8b1ff4ebb7de801932.png"]
[hr][/hr]📊 Development Status


Episode 5 is nearly done. We're wrapping up the final scene, translations are in progress, and we're polishing the last technical adjustments.

We’re also working hard on:

The next episode,

Steam Deck performance,

Save file stability for returning players.


[hr][/hr]⚠️ The Challenges We’re Facing


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/d9dc2e533224cadef13d9960198a260104bbb515.png"]

Lately, our biggest challenge hasn’t been technical… but political.

A wave of censorship has started affecting many narrative games — especially those with adult content, even when it’s mild or story-driven.

We’ve received multiple warning signs: reduced visibility, geo-blocking in certain countries, even sudden bans — often with no clear explanation from the platforms.

And yet, B.E.S.T is far from being a porn game. It’s a story. A universe. Complex characters. A mix of romance, strategy, and social dynamics.

But nowadays, that alone is enough to trigger problems, especially when the rules are vague… or just plain unclear.


[hr][/hr]🧩 So What Happens Next?


We’re doing everything we can to keep B.E.S.T available in the form you know and love — without compromise.

But let’s be honest: 🎭 The future is a bit uncertain.

We’re exploring different options — but one thing is clear: we’re not giving up.

B.E.S.T wasn’t supposed to go beyond this arc. It was a one-shot, originally. But your support, the characters, the world, and everything we’ve built together made us want to go further. Deeper. Bigger.

We’ve seen the questions on the forums about a sequel or a “Season 2.”

Let’s clear a few things up:

The price of the game will not change. This was an Early Access project shaped by your feedback — and we’re staying true to that.

The future is uncertain. A month before launch, we don’t even know if we’ll be able to release the full version without interference. So making long-term plans is risky.

BUT — we’ve talked to players about what some would call a “Season 2.”

We’re not fond of that term. If the B.E.S.T is over, then the game is over. Instead, we think in terms of story arcs.

If we decide to continue the story — a new chapter, a new challenge — it would be in a new, upgraded engine, with proper 4K support, better features, and all the lessons learned from this development.

We won’t be making paid DLC for B.E.S.T. It doesn’t make sense right now, especially with the risks we’re facing.

Again: we have no idea what’s coming. So for now, we’re focused on one thing only — releasing the full version.

The rest — including a possible Episode 6 — will depend entirely on how well the release goes, and what the platform climate looks like afterward.

We’re even considering a “censored” version for general audiences, just to be safe…



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/0c6964f98b80b2be510ea2785ab61fcb9dfe0aee.png"]
[hr][/hr]💬 What You Can Do


If you enjoy the game — if you’ve liked the story, the characters, or just the general vibe — your support matters now more than ever:

Leaving a review on Steam, even a short one, helps a lot. We're currently at 79% positive, and we’re just one percent away from reaching "Very Positive" — a huge milestone before launch.

Join us on Discord and share your thoughts about what you want to see next — or how you think we should handle this situation.


[hr][/hr]❤️ Thank You


Thank you for being here. Thank you for your patience. Thank you for your feedback and trust.

We’ve had doubts. We’ve struggled. But we’ve never stopped wanting to finish this game the way it deserves to be finished.

We’ll see you on August 29. Until then, take care — and keep being the BEST 🏆

— The Dolydev Team

notes.title: DEVLOG 6 : EPISODE 4 !
notes.content:
**Hey B.E.S.T.I.E.S!**  

A quick update on the progress of the episode!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/39d074a993c4085b4ba37dfae37a78c36ffdad4c.png  

So, the match is finally over. It was a huge part of the episode, with animations and a lot of images.  
We’ve added variations based on your choices in previous episodes (whether you trained or not, etc.), and the outcome depends on these choices… but not only that!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/f1b7ed7e1ccc443d532d124739b605f34a4075a9.png  

We’ve also completed what we talked about last time:  

**THE SPECIALIZATION TREE!**  

This system unlocks before the match and allows you to "specialize" once you reach 10 points in a chosen branch.  
For example, if you have 10 points in Sports, you can unlock the SPORTS specialization.  
During the match, there is a unique action tied to this specialization, which changes the way the match plays out.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/1d8c202b25d5168e34bf06dba75fdb3da826f57c.jpg  

So, the match has variations based on both your past choices AND the specialization(s) you have activated!  

In the next episode, we’ll be adding **talents** to these specializations. That means every 5 points, you’ll be able to unlock additional talents, which will provide extra content depending on what you activate.  

All of this helps give more weight to the stats in the game and allows for greater customization of your character!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/40c486a9a8739ed10adcb3a3218d8ab300c34de3.png  

### Now that the match is over, what’s left to do?  

- We have **2 more scenes** to complete in terms of renders and animations.  
- Translations need to be done.  
- Music and sound effects need to be integrated.  

**And that’s it!**  

We are still aiming for a release **after Steam’s March festivals and sales**.  
Once Steam provides the exact dates we can use, I’ll share more details about the episode’s release in the next update!  

Lastly, we will be doing the company’s **financial review** for this first year. I’ll share some insights on the financial side of things to remain transparent with you all!  

Alright, we still have some work left before the episode is complete, so I’ll leave you here for now! See you soon!!!  

**Dolyla**

notes.title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY B.E.S.T !
notes.content:
Hey B.E.S.T.I.E.S!

Wow, it’s already been a year since we launched our game, and what an incredible journey it’s been, all thanks to you! 🎉

Year in Review:

    January 2024: Game launch
    March: Update with additional content for Episodes 1 and 2
    August: Release of Episode 3
    Today: Part 1 of Episode 4 is complete, and Part 2 is in progress!

We now have 30,000 players experiencing this story with us, and we’re deeply grateful for your support. ❤️

Help Us Hit a Milestone!

With 77% positive reviews, we’re so close to reaching 80% (Very Positive)! Your support makes all the difference. If you enjoy the game and haven’t left a review yet, taking a moment to do so on Steam would mean the world to us. It’s a small gesture for you, but it’s huge for us in terms of visibility and discoverability! It would truly be the best anniversary gift you could give us! 🎁

Part 1 or Full Episode? Your Feedback Matters!

We’re hard at work on Part 2 of Episode 4, which will feature sexy scenes, new animations, unforgettable evenings with Kira, Grace, and many more surprises! However, to polish and translate all the content properly, we’re planning to release the full episode after the March sales period. (With NeoFest, the Visual Novel Festival, and the Steam sales all happening at the same time, this timing gives us the best visibility.)

But… we know some of you are eager to dive into the new content! 😅 Part 1, which focuses on phone upgrades, Julia, Madison, Gabriella, and the third B.E.S.T trial, could be released earlier. For those on the “Grace-only” route, her content will be included in Part 2.

What do you prefer?
👉 Wait for the full episode in March
👉 Get Part 1 earlier

Let us know in the comments, and we’ll adapt to your preferences!

Thank you again for this incredible year, for your constructive feedback, and for your passion, which drives us to do our best every day. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts! ❤️

Dolyla

notes.title: Happy New Year !!!
notes.content:
Happy New Year, B.E.S.T.I.E.S! 🎉

I truly hope you're enjoying this festive season! Lots of gifts and new games to try out, right?
As for us, things are speeding up!

The first part of Episode 4 is complete and will move into testing once we've ironed out the coding issues with the new challenge we’ve prepared for you!

We’ve also made plenty of UI adjustments to the in-game phone to offer you more interactions. Since it’s a foundational update, we’ve done our best to get it right so we won’t need to revisit it later, allowing us to focus on advancing the story.

You’ve already seen our new application, OnlyStan.
We’ve also added a "biography" section for the game’s characters. You saw the initial version last time—now here’s the "final" version:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/ad0dfce8a9963cee61ce123b4ac56b273ac23696.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/a4b8193ffe0bf00e0f1fdbef6339f9c23f226a77.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/1e8a7a0b216dfc84e80a9b451acfd5e5142dbf22.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/b5c6c438d17e91ee5918adada304d28a86a0029d.png

Initially, we had a white background... but several players suggested a "dark mode" or a less bright color to reduce eye strain. So, we’ve tried a few options, and this is where you come in:

WHICH COLOR DO YOU PREFER? The original white? The more formal gray? The blue that matches the game’s color scheme? Or the retro-style pink? Let us know your choice in the comments!

Here’s the "final" design for the character profile page:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/eb0be5771a01266e4598682bf4b221eff7113b7a.jpg

The little hearts update dynamically based on your relationship progress with each character. These features lay the groundwork for the characters, so please share your thoughts! We’re excited to hear from you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/5ee26231b03d2c41e05937425c893c69b6faa8c2.png

Now, we’re moving on to the second part of Episode 4, which will be far less "technical" and much more visual.

Part 2 will focus on visuals, renders, animations, and the second match. While Part 1 undergoes testing to ensure all the changes to the phone and the new challenge function smoothly and don’t corrupt your saves, we’ll be advancing Part 2. Our main goal is to deliver the full episode before the next Visual Novel Festival in March.

As for our roadmap this year, here’s the plan:


Complete Episode 4 by early March at the latest.
Episode 5 by July at the latest.
Episode 6 by December at the latest (including a rework of Episode 1’s translation).


We’re really aiming to stick to these deadlines and deliver as much content as possible throughout the year to keep the adventure going.

Regarding the game, more and more of you are playing, and we thank you for that! The game’s review score is steadily climbing (77% positive) as it works its way back to its original score (83%) before Episode 3 and the quiz. 😉 Thanks to the adjustments we made and the option for players to participate or skip challenges, it seems we’ve found a good balance that satisfies more players.

If you haven’t already, please consider leaving a review on Steam to share your thoughts and, if you’re enjoying the game, to support us and help boost the score back to 80%, which would restore our "Very Positive" rating!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/fe42e2503aa1ebc9262be1a47931d8483177bc74.jpg

Well... That’s a lot of talking with not much in the way of previews...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/e519548430e908d61586bf912cbfda0bb8734162.png

But we promise to share more images next time!
See you soon!

Dolyla

notes.title: EPISODE 4 : DEVLOG 1
notes.content:
Hello B.E.S.T.I.E.S!

I hope your vacation went well and you enjoyed it!

For us there were a few small "inconveniences" when episode 3 was released but everything seems to be back to normal!
For information, the phone "bug" has been fixed, the buttons now work as expected!
The Russian and Chinese translations arrived, late, but are there!

We received quite a bit of feedback on the quiz.
Some found it cool and tried hard to find all the solutions, others on the contrary found it very boring.
The goal was not to put you in difficulty on logic or general knowledge, but just to have a test based on this type of skills or knowledge because, logically, our hero takes a test to be the best student.
Don't worry, we don't plan to do any quizzes soon!

Then in terms of free-roam and story, players generally appreciated the choices offered.

As for the update time (namely that our roadmap, as it was initially established, is currently being followed), we are therefore counting on the end of the year for episode 4. We know that the wait can be a little long but overall we are not bad compared to other games of this genre. Of course some have much more content or increased quality which extends development times. But we have counted on offering you an episode every 3-4 months as you have decided. I remind you that a vote on the forum was made from the start to find out if you wanted more frequent updates (part 1 / part 2) or not. It was decided to deliver full episodes to you for more content and less testing or problems between versions etc...

I'm telling you about this because overall the rating of the game dropped in this episode for these reasons:
- Quiz too difficult 
- Development time too long
- Late translation for Russian/Chinese
- Not enough sexual content / or sexual content too difficult to find
- Game not fun enough
- ...

We take all your feedback into account and really hope to improve as we go. Once again, don't forget that the game is in early access too so we can improve it as we progress!

We also know that players are more likely to say when they don't like something than when they like something. This is also why we dose and continue more or less in the same vein!

Finally, know that the scenes of episode 4 are already organized, arranged, the choices are already prepared and the intro is already made.

Come on, let's go back because we still have work to do!

Have a good day and see you soon for the first screens of episode 4!

Dolyla

notes.title: Devlog 8 : 20H00 !
notes.content:
Hello B.E.S.T.I.E.S!

Lots of little news today! 
As you know, Episode 3 is divided by hours and the free-roam represents the evening at Grace's, also divided by hours.
We are at 8:00 p.m., the end of the evening passing at midnight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/111b90efe0d469a6fd7b82c66e2a078db4457a6d.png

Last week was largely used to learn how to code some things including, and I think this will please some players: the arrival of the phone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/ff1fbfb3103666db4a760983f44d3f566dcd2f38.png

So we had to integrate it into Episode 4 at your request... But we found the opportunity to use it before so we spent time on it trying to understand how it works and in the end... Well we are quite satisfied with the result!
This of course needs to be improved over time, but here are the functions that we have managed to integrate:

- The list of dynamic contacts according to your history and the paths you follow.
- You can, at certain times, send messages to girls yourself, again depending on the story and the choices you have made previously.
- Integration of B.E.S.T stats into the phone.
- History of messages received
- A Wallpaper function to change the phone's wallpaper: When you receive photos of girls by message, they are saved in the phone and you can reuse them as wallpaper.

Other functions will come over time. If you have ideas for useful things to add, don't hesitate to leave us comments!

The other part of the time was used for free-roam and in particular the navigation system inside. We have therefore created free-roam in such a way that you do not have to look for where you need to go but to choose. Here is the “main hub” for this evening and how the free-roam will be organized:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/f9d9d75d3be7389c2fedb014d8972f766a07fa1e.jpg

As you see the middle image represents the hub where you can click on girls to talk with them or participate in activities, at the top and bottom the movement bars which tell you which room to go to. Finally obviously events depending on your choices and current routes will take place during this event, characters will be available... or not for you depending on your saves...

Finally, now that all that is done, even if it took us a little longer than expected, it saved us time for episode 4!

All that remains is to chain together the images and animations for the evening and move forward in this free-roam until the end of the episode!

See you soon !

Dolyla

notes.title: DevLog 2 : Réorganization !
notes.content:
Hello to all B.E.S.T participants!

Today a little update on where we are and where we are going!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/1accdfabeeb6a3795c2b3e9107b9803236627aeb.jpg

So this week was not very productive in terms of work on the game itself but much more on meetings with lawyers, accountants, banks... The success of B.E.S.T forced us to review our company plans (basically we just wanted to remain self-employed...) and to open a development company in France... Lots of paperwork, all to better manage taxes and it's not over yet... We're still waiting the official papers to be able to open the professional bank account etc... In short...

The good news from all this is that we will be able to start working peacefully by having the funds for the small family... or even hire to support the project / start other projects!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/e7e630761ea5cdc6bbacca0f7aba210b8b7e16fc.jpg
Besides that, we read all your comments and reviews of the game and we sincerely want to thank you for your opinions, whether positive or negative, because they are very important to us and above all, you give us your opinion on what you would like to find in the game, the improvements that we can make and all the optimizations that we can add! It’s really great to have your feedback and I thank you once again!

So, you gave us your opinion for the end of episode 2:

We are going to release an EPISODE 2 EXTENDED update with what we had planned for the start of episode 3!
This update will add about 20 minutes of additional content, a little lewd, a little romance and a little more action before the planned integration day for episode 3 :)
We will try to release it next month, while we finish the 2 big scenes of this update and do the translations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/ab0dfd23d0a41cdd0c29759b84e5fa707c08d4e6.jpg

In terms of improvements that would be interesting and feasible for episode 3, there are points on which we tend to agree with you:

- Add an interactive map to the game for the player's movements so that he goes to the stadium / gymnasium / class etc... and has several possible choices on the map depending on the moment in the story... Rather than to go through buttons, this would make the game more lively and dynamic and would give the player more of an impression of "playing". We will try to create this map for episode 3.

- We had overestimated the principle that players replay the game several times to see all the possible paths. Indeed, it seems that the players quickly chose their favorite and do not play another game once they have reached the end, because they are waiting for the rest of the story with her... (Grace would have a good proportion of players on this subject it seems :) ).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/ec9fc0c754c969ee266e9b2a557418421fd7c573.jpg

We are therefore going to try not to do too many parallel paths as we did from episode 1 with Red and Blue but rather to keep paths by girls by having the maximum scene length and not in parallel. I don't know if you understand what I'm writing to you but basically the choices will have an impact on the content of the scene but more on the appearance of the scene itself.

- The phone is something we have already implemented in the game but we are only using the chat function for now. We will try to use the phone better but we will do it from episode 4 for "logical" reasons from that point on in the storyline. The goal is also not to take too long to integrate new things and not to make progress on game updates...

- In terms of the events, we are going to try to implement some gameplay elements in the next ones, nothing too crazy so as not to put the players in difficulty either, but just enough to make them "participate" during an event sport by tapping the space bar to increase the shooting gauge on the next match for example... Let the player be active in the game and no longer just directed by the story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/e8c3ee9b2fe497ae4dc50afdbebc95ed13412e2c.jpg

- Finally we are going to try to set up a tree of choices within the game for Episode 4, so that you can see what paths you have unlocked and what you might have missed! We say Episode 4 because it's a big feature and at the moment we have no idea how to implement it but it will give us time to research while we do Episode 3 calmly.

These are the points on which we will try to improve... If you see other important things, do not hesitate to tell us via the comments or the forums! Once again we will integrate new things gradually but this must not be at the expense of the progress of the overall story... We want to succeed in offering you between 2 and 3 complete episodes per year and let's not put additional delays on features that wouldn't add much to the game.

Well, there you have it, I wrote a big piece today! For those who are still here reading me... Thank you! And I'll see you in 2 weeks for the next Devlog which will be dedicated to this EXTENDED UPDATE!

Waiting for...

Dolyla

notes.title: 5K Wishlists on STEAM ! And a lot of news :)
notes.content:
Hi everybody !

These days were full of events for us and we continue to enhance the game to provide you the best experience of B.E.S.T when it will be released in January on STEAM !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/4a528eaeb3aaa3c727557c9b5853a4e266e9ae77.jpg

Talking about the release, we are now at more than 5000 players that have added B.E.S.T to their wishlist and it's wonderful cause it's an important milestone for us to continue the project and have sufficient funds for further development.

B.E.S.T will be sold at 11.99$ with a reduction for the release (Around 9.99$). The 2 first chapters of the 6-8 planned for season 1 are ready.

So after the UI enhancements shown before, we have added a new feature to the game : The Walkthrough Mod !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/336bb4b9688affee7e4b40ae407284a58b29f81e.jpg

Walkthrough mod will be a DLC sold at 1.99$ and will cover all the season, when an episode will be released, walkthrough will be updated too. This DLC is done for the players who don't want to seek how to reach some scenes, play some paths... But we strongly advise to play without Walkthrough mod for your first time ! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/62c5030059994407b597143b565f67da02aa4c11.jpg

About the game itself here are the updates of the game :

 New improved translation in English with a proofreader.
 Renders and animation remade for Red's path
 Scenes added for the finish of the episode with one lewd scene, a romantic one and an ending scene you will discover...
  Coming next trailer added
  Changes about how statistics affects some paths / variables optimization 
  Walkthrough in EN/FR to have information about the paths, the statistics and the "best choice" to make in every situation.
  Achievements added to the game and to Steam for the end of Episode 2.


So... Now we are on a new feature not included in the game yet that will add a little fun: Found the Mini-Rufus !
In some renders you will have some mini-Rufus hidden in the background... You will have to collect them for rewards. This will be our last "addition" to Episode 1 and 2. Then we will go work to Episode 3.

About Episode 3 we are already in but won't say more and let you discover it through the end of episode 2 !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114556/2dce0e783a3b65f812dfb41c2fdd2ccbd0ee1415.png

Well I think that's all... I will let you there now cause we have so much work till the release date... And Christmas will arrive... 

See you soon !

Dolyla
